author: B692LKalvaros

title: MASSAGE WITH AROMATIC OILS.
text: Spectacular! The Mood of the place is beautiful, but certainly the best is the skill of the masseuse who attended me; her name was Nuan. They really are Thai masseurs, who know the body and its anatomy well. I was surprised that when I was having the massage he asked me if I had had arm ailments, which was true! I was very impressed and excellent with the Service and Service. After the massage you will be treated to a floral bath in the Jacuzzi. Super recommended!
author: kelly j
